From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>

Subject: Pipeline playbook & decision log — QBR prep

Team,

I put together a compact playbook and decision-log template to help us finish the QBR prep this week. Goal: produce a one-page account summary + a single-row decision for each priority deal (commit / needs exec / push to next quarter). Please see attached pipeline_playbook_template.xlsx.

Ask:
- Rishi: populate top-10 forecasted ARR and close probability by EOD today for the deals you own. Highlight any asks that need pricing/credits approval.
- Marcus: add the account-by-account bullets for technical blockers and integration readiness.
- Laura: run a quick sanity check on consolidated forecast math and call out any double-counted seats/usage.

Quick rules for the decision log (please follow exactly):
- Decision values: Commit | ExecApprovalNeeded | OnHold | PushNextQ
- Required fields: ARR, CloseDateTarget, PrimaryRisk, RequiredAction, Owner, EscalationContact

I'll consolidate and circulate a one-pager for the exec QBR by 3pm PT. If anything needs an immediate escalation (discounts > 20% or SLA requests), mark it in the "RequiredAction" column and cc procurement.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Director, Revenue Strategy
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pipeline_playbook_template.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Pipeline playbook & decision log — QBR prep

Naomi — thanks. Draft updates below (top items from my book):

1) Acme Corp (RD-ACM-2027) — $420k ARR, CloseProb 65%, TargetClose 2027-07-31
   - PrimaryRisk: procurement turnaround + data residency clause in SOW.
   - RequiredAction: Price approval for 18% discount + sign-off from Legal on redline.
   - Owner: rishi_malhotra; EscalationContact: Lydia Chen / Acme Procurement.

2) Greenline Health — $210k ARR, CloseProb 40%, TargetClose 2027-08-15
   - PrimaryRisk: integration timeline with their EMR. Marcus is tracking technical readiness.
   - RequiredAction: technical commitment + 30-day pilot clause negotiation.

3) OptiRetail (mid-market) — $95k ARR, CloseProb 75%
   - PrimaryRisk: seat-count confirmation.

I flagged Acme for exec approval because procurement is asking for language that weakens our data isolation terms. If we don't approve the 18% now, we risk pushing to next quarter. Request: can we get a procurement/legal review slot today?

On the template: I'll upload a populated CSV to the shared Drive in 30 minutes.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Head of North America Sales
Redwood Inference
